ns2:section.sectionText: (Be sure to enroll in the desired credit amount (2 or 4 hours) for this variable credit course). Meets last two weeks, Tu-F, May 27-30, and M-F, June 2-6. Required overnight field trip June 4 & 5. A $45 non-waived course fee will be assessed to the student's tuition/fees bill for the field trip. In addition, the student will be responsible for meals and one night lodging expenses. Contact the instructor (fschlipf@uiuc.edu) with questions or for further details about the details of the course.
